notes: §2002:14.8.21.3 GR1: a zero-length ODO group (count 0, §2002:13.16.36.3 GR8a) ends INSPECT at once, so the tally stays 05. Identifier-1 takes its sending length even in format 3, where it is also receiving: an ODO group with its object inside, at count 2, under TALLYING ALL "A" REPLACING ALL "A" BY "B" tallies 2 and replaces only the current extent, giving [5BBAAA], not the receiving maximum [5BBBBB] (§2002:13.16.36.3 GR8b). The --std 2002 run of g2-inspect-length-and-scan matched the derived output.
